Brisa BG-5 Fiber Gateway
Quick Start Guide

WHAT YOU NEED
- Ethernet cable (included)
- Laptop or phone with a web browser

PORTS
Port            Type       Notes
PON             SC/APC     Connect the fiber cable from the wall outlet
LAN 1-2         RJ-45      Gigabit Ethernet to computers or switches
Phone 1         RJ-11      Analog phone line
Power           DC-IN      12 V adapter only

STATUS LIGHTS
Light      Status       Meaning
Power      On           Device is powered
           Off          No power
PON        Blinking     Registering with the network
           On           Fiber link is up
           Off          No fiber signal
Internet   On           Connected to the internet
           Blinking     Traffic
Alarm      On           Hardware failure, contact support

INSTALLATION
1. Connect the fiber cable to the PON port.
2. Connect a computer to LAN 1 with the Ethernet cable.
3. Plug in the power adapter. Wait until the PON light stays on.
4. Open http://192.168.8.1 in a browser and sign in with the password on the label.
